feature: Public MSP SOW viewer and signer (#4001, Feature #1663) -- artifacts/portal/src/pages/msp-sow-public.tsx, route /sow/:shareToken, no authentication. Wired to GET /api/public/sows/:shareToken and POST /api/public/sows/:shareToken/sign (artifacts/api-server/src/routes/msp-sow.ts). Filed under #4250 because CLAUDE.md's Test Coverage scope line previously named the wrong directory (artifacts/msp-portal instead of artifacts/portal), leaving this real money/legal-signature public flow with zero manifest coverage.
notes: WHAT THIS COVERS: the real (status, body) contract on both public routes -- 404 for an unknown share token, 410 for an expired share link, the signature data withheld from the public GET response (server deliberately omits signatureData -- see the route's own comment), 400 for a malformed sign payload, and a real UI walk confirming the public page mounts and renders for a valid, unauthenticated visit with no login required.

NOT ASSERTED: a full end-to-end sign against a real live SOW row, since that would consume the row's one-time signable state on whatever data backs {{DEPLOY_URL}} and this manifest doesn't control live msp_sows rows. The signing contract (200 body, and the 409 already-signed / 410 expired / 403 access-control paths) is documented from direct reading of artifacts/api-server/src/routes/msp-sow.ts:905-983 rather than fabricated as an assertion here.
ENV VARS (BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables): DEPLOY_URL only -- this route needs no auth token, by design (the share link itself is the credential).

NOT YET RUN via shaneapp://runTest as of this build: BuildConsole's local instance resolves test-manifests/ against the dedicated dev-server checkout, which only receives this worktree's commits at BuildConsole's own end-of-build merge (Git #1371/#1372 worktree isolation). Verified instead by direct reading of msp-sow.ts (the exact status/body pairs this manifest asserts) and msp-sow-public.tsx (the UI copy asserted below is the page's own literal GONE_COPY string). Re-run this manifest via shaneapp://runTest once merged.
